caption:
God feels slow — like He forgot you're still waiting. But read closer: the one in a hurry was always Him. (Galatians 1:21-24 devotional)

His silence feels like distance, so you read “Arabia” as three quiet years of retreat and assume He's gone silent on you too. But Acts says Paul preached “immediately” — Arabia was a whole region, and he was already running from day one. What looks like your long wait is God running to reach sinners; even the closed door is His love in a hurry.
